title: DEC-240 follow-ups: broaden the install and output scans, test a transitive -g install, tidy diagnostic substitutions
description: Non-building follow-ups from the Opus review of #684 (QCLI-535), not built there. N1: the install scan matches only the literal "npm", [ ... "install" ... ] array form in scripts/ and scripts/qualification, and the output scan only the steps. expression form, so both are narrower than their test titles say; broaden them or retitle. N3 (reviewer, verbatim): The proof installs the failing package as the top-level spec via --prefix, but the CI threat is a transitive dependency under -g. The conclusion holds; the object tested differs by one hop. N4 (reviewer, verbatim): Two $(...) calls remain inside arguments, both in diagnostic echoes only: release.yml:88 and lore-check.yml:267. Neither feeds a gate. Also from the review, routed elsewhere: whether DEC-240 (1) covers project dependency installs was ruled out by DEC-240 (a3).

acceptanceCriteria.text: The install scan and the output scan cover the forms their titles claim, or their titles say what they cover
A test installs a package whose TRANSITIVE dependency has a failing postinstall under -g with --ignore-scripts and succeeds, with a control that fails
The two diagnostic echoes assign their substitution to a variable first
